categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production and sales of various single-sided and double-sided bright high-performance electrolytic copper foil products. The company operates two major electrolytic copper foil production bases in Yunmeng and Anlu. Products are categorized into lithium-ion battery copper foil and electronic circuit copper foil, with applications spanning new energy vehicles, energy storage devices, consumer electronics, and printed circuit boards.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses self-designed and continuously optimized electrolytic copper foil production line capabilities, including copper dissolution, precision purification, stable foil generation, reliable surface treatment, and flexible steady-state automatic control. Core technologies include electrochemical deposition processes, surface roughening and oxidation prevention treatments, and specialized additive formulations. The company has developed capabilities in ultra-thin copper foil production (down to 4.5μm) and high-strength copper foil manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include major lithium-ion battery manufacturers (power battery, energy storage battery producers) and electronic circuit board manufacturers (covering copper-clad laminates and printed circuit boards). End markets include new energy vehicles, energy storage systems, consumer electronics, telecommunications, optical electronics, automotive electronics, and industrial control equipment. The company serves leading battery manufacturers and PCB producers globally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Yunmeng and Anlu, Hubei Province. Sales are distributed across multiple regions including East China (35.61% of revenue), South China (31.56%), Southwest China (17.10%), Central China (14.62%), Northwest China (0.76%), Northeast China (0.28%), and North China (0.07%). The company has established subsidiaries including operations in Jiangsu Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the upstream to midstream segments of the supply chain. It serves as a key material supplier to battery manufacturers and PCB producers, providing essential copper foil materials that are critical components in lithium-ion batteries and electronic circuit boards. The company sources raw materials (primarily copper) and supplies finished copper foil products to downstream manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes research and development of ultra-thin and high-strength lithium-ion battery copper foil, high-performance electronic circuit copper foil for 5G/6G applications, and emerging technologies including solid-state battery materials and composite copper foil. R&D focuses on improving product performance, reducing production costs through process optimization, developing specialized additives, and advancing automation and intelligence in manufacturing. The company collaborates with universities on product innovation.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of electrolytic copper foil products using a 'copper material price plus processing fee' pricing model. Revenue is recognized when customers take control of goods (upon signature or collection). The company also generates minor revenue from sales of copper slag, waste copper, and other byproducts. All sales are conducted through direct sales channels with no distribution intermediaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Longyuan Huaxin (龙电华鑫), Jiayuan Technology (嘉元科技), Defu Technology (德福科技), Norde New Materials (诺德新材料), and Touguan Copper Foil (铜冠铜箔). The company is recognized as a leading high-performance copper foil manufacturer with national high-tech enterprise status and 'Little Giant' designation. It maintains stable partnerships with numerous leading battery and PCB manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company achieved 2024 revenue of RMB 4.786 billion (40.13% increase from 2023's RMB 3.415 billion). However, net profit declined to a loss of RMB 84.2 million from a profit of RMB 53.1 million in 2023, primarily due to intense market competition and lower processing fees. Total assets reached RMB 6.355 billion at year-end 2024. The company has demonstrated strong revenue growth but faced profitability challenges in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through advanced ultra-thin copper foil technology (6μm and below), high-strength and high-elongation products, comprehensive product specifications (8μm to 210μm), and superior surface treatment capabilities. Key competitive advantages include self-designed production line optimization capabilities, extensive R&D collaboration with universities, 120 patents and 6 software copyrights, and established relationships with leading battery and PCB manufacturers. The company emphasizes product quality, technical innovation, and cost efficiency.
